dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Oh, so you know him too? Has he tricked you, then?

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Huh. I didn't think he was a fibber... He seems like a good person to me.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: I guess there's just a whole bunch of things in this world that we kids don't get.

dialogues.speaker: Anaka
dialogues.text: Still, why would Uncle Giustino have come over here if Petrichor was so awesome...?
